title: A/R Summary: a payment shows as soon as the report is reloaded
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has one open invoice, {Invoice-A}, of $500.00 on today's date, and nothing else open.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-22 Fresh Payment.
  • {Invoice-A}'s page is open in a second browser tab, ready to record a payment.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s Total and the Totals row.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Record a payment of $200.00 on {Invoice-A}.
  4. Switch back to the A/R Summary tab.
  5. Reload the page.
  6. Read {Customer-A}'s Total and the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both read $500.00.
  • Step 2: {Invoice-A}'s page shows.
  • Step 3: the payment is saved and the invoice's balance is $300.00.
  • Step 4: A/R Summary shows, not yet reloaded.
  • Step 5: the report reloads, still with only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • Step 6: both read $300.00 (500.00 − 200.00): the payment shows straight away.

On a test site the reports read the same data the payment is written to (tech plan: "Staging/QA reader = writer"), so the reload shows it at once. In production they read a copy that can be about a second behind; question 9 (part 2) asks Chris Ward whether a delay is acceptable. If this case is run on production, wait a few seconds before step 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R1, A/R Summary description: “A/R Summary: "Each customer’s unpaid balance as of the selected date, after unused credit memos and deposits, with a breakdown of overdue amounts."”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §1 Clarifications, intake 1: “~1 s replica lag accepted earlier as not a Product question.”
  • Tech plan §3 D1: “Replica live in prod since 2026-10-18. Staging/QA reader = writer.”

  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "The native report info icon sits right of the title; title, icon and ⋯ stay on one line, filter row below. S8-R1, S8-R2." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, light")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")
